subject.title: Flaky tests on Windows/WSL: timeouts and ENOENT in pi-tools workspace-paths & safe-bins

question: Should the unrelated closing reference in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90273 be removed so this issue can close on the current-main non-reproduction evidence, or is a fresh WSL reproduction required first?
rationale: Automation must not close an issue while an open PR claims it with closing syntax, and it cannot decide whether maintainers consider the existing non-reproduction evidence sufficient after correcting that relationship.

options.title: Correct link, then close
options.body: Remove the closing reference from the fs-safe PR and close this issue unless a focused current-main WSL run reproduces the original pi-tools failures.

options.title: Require fresh WSL proof
options.body: Keep this issue open until the two original pi-tools tests are rerun on current main under WSL with a complete failure or passing transcript.

options.title: Accept umbrella relationship
options.body: Keep the closing reference and intentionally treat the fs-safe hardlink work as resolving this broader Windows test issue despite the different files and failure mode.

recommendation.title: Correct link, then close
recommendation.body: Remove the closing reference from the fs-safe PR and close this issue unless a focused current-main WSL run reproduces the original pi-tools failures.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest affected-test history and authored the prior issue-level review defining the intended scope.
